purpose: Catches macro layout, power grid capacity, and boundary pin placement bottlenecks before cell placement and CTS locked-in constraints make floorplan changes cost weeks of rework.

checks.question: Are macro channel widths compliant with minimum track requirements for global signals plus boundary power ring rules?
checks.evidence_demanded: Floorplan channel width map overlay with track count and routing blockage verification report.
checks.red_flag: Macro channels narrower than 12um (or less than 1.5x minimum spacing required for power rings + signal track routing).
checks.why_it_matters: Causes catastrophic post-CTS global route congestion overflow and track starvation that requires full floorplan re-spins late in the flow.

checks.question: Does the static power grid (VDD/VSS straps) satisfy target IR drop requirements with max metal layer utilization under 20% on signal layers?
checks.evidence_demanded: Static IR drop calculation report and top-metal layer resource allocation map.
checks.red_flag: Static IR drop prediction exceeding 2% VDD or power grid straps blocking more than 30% of routing tracks on intermediate signal layers.
checks.why_it_matters: Forces severe routing congestion on signal layers or unresolvable static/dynamic IR drop failures at signoff.

checks.question: Are macro orientation and pin alignments facing open core logic rather than dead-end chip corners or adjacent macro walls?
checks.evidence_demanded: Visual floorplan pin access map and port flightline density report.
checks.red_flag: Macro pins facing narrow dead-end channels or directly abutting an opposing macro's pin boundary.
checks.why_it_matters: Creates high pin-density hotspots that cause un-routable local DRC explosions during detailed routing.

checks.question: Is total block core utilization below node-specific threshold bounds considering pin-density limits?
checks.evidence_demanded: Floorplan utilization summary and local area cell density histogram.
checks.red_flag: Core utilization exceeding 70% on 7nm/5nm FinFET (or >80% on 28nm planar) prior to placement.
checks.why_it_matters: Leaves zero capacity for CTS buffer insertion, hold fixing, and timing optimization, leading to late-stage placement failure.

checks.question: Are halo boundaries and placement blockages correctly specified around all hard macro perimeters?
checks.evidence_demanded: Keepout blockage definition file and visual floorplan overlay.
checks.red_flag: Missing macro placement halos or keepout zones under 5um on macro edges containing active pins.
checks.why_it_matters: Allows standard cells to place directly against macro boundaries, blocking routing tracks needed for macro pin access.

checks.question: Are block boundary port locations aligned with top-level floorplan constraints and multi-partition flightlines?
checks.evidence_demanded: Top-level pin assignment guide and boundary port distance delta report.
checks.red_flag: Block boundary ports placed in floorplan corners or misaligned with top-level interconnect corridors.
checks.why_it_matters: Forces long interconnect wiring detours, causing un-closable top-level setup timing failures.

kill_questions: Are macro channels wide enough for clock tree buffers and power rails without exceeding 75% local cell density?
Is the static power grid sufficient to keep static IR drop under 2% without starving M3-M5 routing tracks?
waiver_culture: Narrow macro channels are frequently waived under schedule pressure to save core area, resulting in weeks of detailed-routing DRC cleanup and timing closure churn later.

purpose: Validates standard cell placement stability, setup timing slack profile, and global routing congestion before clock tree synthesis commits heavy buffer networks and locks down registers.

checks.question: What is the shape of the setup slack histogram, and is there a long tail of failing paths below zero?
checks.evidence_demanded: Setup slack histogram plot by clock domain and top 100 failing path report.
checks.red_flag: Setup WNS worse than -300ps or a broad multi-hundred-path tail below zero rather than a steep wall at zero.
checks.why_it_matters: CTS will add clock skew and latency that expands a negative setup tail into thousands of un-closable post-CTS timing failures.

checks.question: Is global routing congestion overflow (GRC) well below 0.5% with no concentrated 2D hotspots?
checks.evidence_demanded: Global route congestion map and max GRC overflow report.
checks.red_flag: Max local GRC overflow exceeding 1.5% in any 5x5 tile region.
checks.why_it_matters: Clock tree synthesis will add thousands of clock buffers, turning minor pre-CTS congestion into severe detailed routing DRC storms.

checks.question: Are high-fanout nets (HFNs) and reset/enable trees properly identified and limited prior to clock insertion?
checks.evidence_demanded: High-fanout net report sorted by fanout count and net drive capacitance.
checks.red_flag: Un-buffered signal nets with fanout exceeding 500 loads operating without explicit placement tree constraints.
checks.why_it_matters: Unconstrained HFNs cause severe local routing bottlenecks and massive post-CTS setup timing degradation.

checks.question: Are high-density placement clusters or local cell density spikes above 85% present in the core?
checks.evidence_demanded: Local placement density map (20um x 20um grid resolution).
checks.red_flag: Local density hotspots exceeding 90% utilization within standard cell rows.
checks.why_it_matters: CTS engines cannot insert clock buffers or latency-matching cells near dense register banks, forcing long buffer detours and high skew.

checks.question: Has SDC constraint sanity checking passed with zero unconstrained endpoints or invalid clock transfers?
checks.evidence_demanded: SDC check_timing / check_design audit report.
checks.red_flag: Presence of unconstrained register input/output pins, un-handled generated clocks, or missing clock group definitions.
checks.why_it_matters: Physical synthesis will optimize against garbage constraints, distorting placement and masking real timing failures.

checks.question: Are scan chain re-ordering and boundary chain assignments verified legal against floorplan placement?
checks.evidence_demanded: Scan chain trace report and wirelength delta report.
checks.red_flag: Scan path wirelength exceeding 15% of total signal routing length or crossing floorplan boundaries back and forth.
checks.why_it_matters: Criss-crossing scan chains waste routing tracks and cause hold timing violations post-CTS.

kill_questions: Does the setup timing slack histogram show a sharp wall at zero, or is there a long failing tail below -300ps?
Is the max global routing overflow below 0.5% before clock buffers are added to the layout?
waiver_culture: Pre-CTS setup timing tails are often waived assuming clock tree useful skew will fix them, which invariably leads to CTS power bloat and hold timing disasters.

purpose: Ensures full-chip timing closure across all PVT corners, extraction modes, and operating modes with zero setup/hold violations and clean signal integrity.

checks.question: Is WNS/TNS exactly zero (or positive) across all signoff PVT corners and extraction corners for setup and hold?
checks.evidence_demanded: Multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) timing signoff summary matrix report.
checks.red_flag: Any setup WNS < 0ps or hold WNS < 0ps on non-waived paths in any signoff corner.
checks.why_it_matters: Non-zero negative slack in signoff STA directly translates to functional silicon timing failure or reduced operating frequency.

checks.question: Are all crosstalk delta-delay and SI noise (glitch) violations within library threshold limits across all nets?
checks.evidence_demanded: Signal integrity (SI) noise calculation report and crosstalk delay impact summary.
checks.red_flag: Peak glitch voltage exceeding 20% VDD on low-noise inputs or crosstalk delay adding >150ps to critical paths.
checks.why_it_matters: Unresolved crosstalk glitches cause functional state corruption or intermittent silicon failures that elude static timing analysis.

checks.question: Are all SDC waivers formally reviewed, documented, and backed by hardware/RTL verification?
checks.evidence_demanded: Formal SDC waiver log with signed justification for every set_false_path, set_multicycle_path, and set_clock_groups.
checks.red_flag: Undocumented or blanket wildcard false paths (e.g. set_false_path -to [get_pins *]) lacking individual CDC synchronizer proofs.
checks.why_it_matters: Blanket waivers mask real timing paths, guaranteeing functional silicon failure due to un-synthesized cross-domain transfers.

checks.question: Have clock transition times, max capacitance, and max fanout constraints passed clean with zero violations?
checks.evidence_demanded: DRC timing constraint report (max_transition, max_capacitance, max_fanout).
checks.red_flag: Clock pin max_transition violations exceeding 100ps in fast corners or signal transition violations >250ps.
checks.why_it_matters: Slew rate degradation causes severe dynamic power bloat, excessive noise sensitivity, and unpredictable cell delay variation.

checks.question: Is clock latency and skew variation across PVT corners matching extracted SPEF timing predictions?
checks.evidence_demanded: Clock tree latency/skew report per corner comparing pre-route predictions vs SPEF post-route STA.
checks.red_flag: Clock skew exceeding 10% of clock period or latency variation >25% between min and max operating corners.
checks.why_it_matters: Excessive clock skew eats timing margin and causes catastrophic hold timing races across fast-corner operation.

checks.question: Were SPEF parasitics extracted using 3D field-solver accuracy on all critical paths and clock trunks?
checks.evidence_demanded: Parasitic extraction (PEX) audit log showing 3D/selective-3D extraction status for critical nets.
checks.red_flag: Critical setup paths with <10ps slack extracted using fast 2D approximation modes.
checks.why_it_matters: 2D extraction underestimates coupling capacitance in advanced node metal stacks, hiding real signoff timing violations.

kill_questions: Are there any un-justified negative slack paths or wildcard false path waivers anywhere in the MCMM signoff matrix?
Has 3D parasitic extraction been run on all critical timing paths and clock networks?
waiver_culture: Small hold violations in fast corners are sometimes waived under tapeout deadline pressure, leading to dead-on-arrival silicon if post-silicon clock tree skew exceeds expectations.

purpose: Guarantees absolute manufacturability, electrical connectivity, and rule compliance (DRC/LVS/ERC/Antenna) using golden external signoff engines prior to mask generation.

checks.question: Is the full-chip signoff DRC report 100% clean with zero un-waived design rule violations?
checks.evidence_demanded: Golden external signoff DRC summary log and waiver database file.
checks.red_flag: Any remaining un-waived routing short, spacing, or minimum area violation in the signoff deck.
checks.why_it_matters: Physical DRC errors cause short circuits or open wires during lithography, resulting in 0% silicon yield.

checks.question: Is Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) 100% clean with exact matching of nets, instances, ports, and device properties?
checks.evidence_demanded: Golden external LVS comparison report and netlist extraction comparison log.
checks.red_flag: LVS status reporting unmatched nets, device parameter mismatches, or floating substrate taps.
checks.why_it_matters: LVS mismatches mean the physical layout does not match the logical netlist, causing total chip non-functionality.

checks.question: Are all antenna ratio violations resolved via diode insertion or top-layer metal hopping?
checks.evidence_demanded: Antenna rule check summary report.
checks.red_flag: Un-protected gate pins attached to long metal tracks exceeding maximum process antenna ratio limits.
checks.why_it_matters: Charge accumulation during plasma etching destroys thin gate oxide layers, causing permanent gate breakdown in silicon.

checks.question: Have Electrical Rule Checks (ERC) passed clean for floating gates, power-domain shorts, and substrate tap density?
checks.evidence_demanded: ERC summary report and well-tap spacing verification log.
checks.red_flag: Floating input gates, substrate well-tap distance exceeding process limits, or cross-power-domain leakage paths.
checks.why_it_matters: Causes CMOS latch-up conditions or un-controlled leakage currents that permanently damage the chip.

checks.question: Is dummy metal fill density fully compliant with process window density rules (min/max density per layer tile)?
checks.evidence_demanded: Density check report across all metal/via layers in 50um x 50um window tiles.
checks.red_flag: Tile windows failing minimum density requirements on lower thin metal layers or density gradients >20% across adjacent tiles.
checks.why_it_matters: Causes Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) thickness variations, leading to metal over-etching or under-etching shorts.

checks.question: Are ESD protection structures and guard rings fully verified around all I/O pads and power domain boundaries?
checks.evidence_demanded: ESD rule check log and pad ring connectivity report.
checks.red_flag: Missing ESD clamp cells or broken guard rings on primary input/output pad cells.
checks.why_it_matters: Destroys silicon on first handling during packaging and testing due to electrostatic discharge.

kill_questions: Is the golden signoff DRC and LVS report 100% clean with zero un-waived routing shorts or net mismatches?
Are all process antenna violations fully resolved or protected with verified ESD/antenna diodes?
waiver_culture: Density rule violations in dummy fill layers are commonly waived to meet tapeout slots, occasionally causing CMP planarization defects that destroy yield on specific wafer zones.
